record.name: Kel Dor
record.description: The Kel Dor are a humanoid species native to the planet Dorin, which has a toxic atmosphere that requires them to wear breath masks when off-world. They are known for their darkvision and adaptability to harsh environments.

innate_traits.name: Darkvision
innate_traits.narrative: Your large, sensitive eyes evolved to see through Dorin's perpetual darkness and toxic atmosphere. You can perceive details in conditions that would leave other species completely blind.

mechanics.name: Enhanced Sight
mechanics.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

innate_traits.name: Toxic Resistance
innate_traits.narrative: Your physiology evolved to survive in Dorin's toxic atmosphere, developing natural defenses against poisons and toxins that would kill other species instantly.

mechanics.name: Poison Resistance
mechanics.description: You have resistance to poison damage.

mechanics.name: Poison Immunity
mechanics.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison.

innate_traits.name: Environmental Adaptation
innate_traits.narrative: Your species evolved in one of the galaxy's most hostile environments, developing incredible resilience to environmental hazards and the ability to survive in conditions that would kill others.

mechanics.name: Hazard Resistance
mechanics.description: You have advantage on saving throws against environmental hazards.

mechanics.name: Extended Breath Holding
mechanics.description: You can hold your breath for twice as long.

appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe a Kel Dor character. Emphasize their distinctive breath mask, which is essential for survival off their homeworld, and their large, expressive eyes that convey both caution and wisdom. Their dark skin should reflect their adaptation to harsh environments. Consider their natural caution and the way they carry themselves with deliberate, careful movements that reflect their survival instincts.

class_synergies.narrative: Kel Dor's natural adaptability and Darkvision make them exceptional Scouts, able to navigate and explore dangerous environments that others cannot survive.
mechanical_benefits: Darkvision trait enables exploration in low-light conditions
Environmental Adaptation trait enhances survival in harsh environments
Toxic Resistance trait allows exploration of dangerous areas

class_synergies.narrative: Kel Dor's natural adaptability and environmental resistance make them excellent Engineers, able to work in hazardous conditions and toxic environments.
mechanical_benefits: Toxic Resistance trait enables work in dangerous environments
Environmental Adaptation trait supports hazardous operations
High Wisdom aids in problem-solving and technical work

class_synergies.narrative: Kel Dor's natural stealth and environmental abilities make them excellent Operatives, able to operate in conditions that would incapacitate others.
mechanical_benefits: Darkvision trait enhances stealth and reconnaissance
Environmental Adaptation trait enables operations in harsh conditions
Natural caution aids in infiltration and intelligence gathering

class_synergies.narrative: Kel Dor's natural resilience and protective instincts make them excellent Guardians, able to protect others in dangerous environments.
mechanical_benefits: Toxic Resistance trait enables protection in hazardous conditions
Environmental Adaptation trait supports defensive operations

faction_synergies.narrative: Kel Dor are natural explorers and surveyors, using their environmental adaptations to chart dangerous worlds and toxic environments.
Kel Dor have served the Republic as scouts and engineers, their unique abilities making them valuable assets in hazardous operations.
Many Kel Dor prefer to work as independent explorers and surveyors, using their natural adaptations to explore the galaxy's most dangerous environments.

level_5.description: Your environmental adaptations become more refined, allowing you to sense and navigate hazardous environments with greater precision.
level_5.mechanical_benefit: Increase your darkvision range from 60 feet to 90 feet, and gain advantage on Perception checks to detect environmental hazards.

level_10.description: Your toxic resistance reaches new heights, allowing you to survive in even more dangerous environments.
level_10.mechanical_benefit: You gain immunity to non-magical poison damage, and you can survive in toxic atmospheres without a breath mask for up to 1 hour per day.

level_15.description: Your environmental mastery allows you to use hazardous conditions to your advantage in combat.
level_15.mechanical_benefit: When fighting in toxic or hazardous environments, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls, representing your comfort in dangerous conditions.

level_20.description: Your environmental adaptations reach their peak, making you nearly immune to environmental hazards.
level_20.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on all saving throws against environmental effects, and you can survive in any atmosphere without special equipment for up to 24 hours.

cultural_features.name: Breath Mask Rituals
cultural_features.description: Kel Dor have sacred rituals surrounding their breath masks, which are not just survival equipment but symbols of their connection to Dorin and their cultural identity.
cultural_features.narrative_impact: Provides cultural depth and spiritual connection. Can be used for character development and cultural interactions.

cultural_features.name: Environmental Wisdom
cultural_features.description: Kel Dor traditions emphasize understanding and respecting dangerous environments, teaching others how to survive in hazardous conditions.
cultural_features.narrative_impact: Creates educational opportunities and cultural exchange. Can be used for teaching and mentoring scenarios.

cultural_features.name: Cautious Exploration
cultural_features.description: Kel Dor exploration traditions emphasize careful, methodical approaches to unknown environments, valuing safety and preparation over speed.
cultural_features.narrative_impact: Provides unique problem-solving approaches and cultural perspective. Can be used for planning and preparation scenarios.

cultural_features.name: Survival Meditation
cultural_features.description: Kel Dor practice meditation techniques that enhance their environmental awareness and help them maintain calm in dangerous situations.
cultural_features.narrative_impact: Provides character development opportunities and stress management. Can be used for maintaining composure in crisis situations.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your body is perfectly adapted to toxic environments, allowing you to function normally in conditions that would kill other species.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on all skill checks in toxic environments, and you can sense the presence of toxins and poisons within 30 feet.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your enhanced vision allows you to operate effectively in complete darkness, where others would be completely blind.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on Perception checks in darkness, and you can navigate dark environments without penalty.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your natural resilience allows you to survive and operate in extremely hazardous environments that would incapacitate others.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on saving throws against environmental hazards, and you can move through hazardous terrain without penalty.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your physiology can handle extreme pressure conditions, allowing you to operate in environments that would crush other species.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You can survive in high-pressure environments without special equipment, and you have advantage on saving throws against pressure-related damage.

progression_balance: Species progression enhancements focus on environmental survival and hazard resistance, complementing rather than overshadowing class features
Environmental adaptation improvements maintain the species' unique identity while providing meaningful advancement
Toxic resistance and darkvision provide situational advantages without making the species universally superior
cultural_integration: Cultural features focus on environmental wisdom and survival traditions rather than mechanical advantages
Breath mask rituals and environmental wisdom provide unique roleplaying opportunities and cultural depth
Cautious exploration and survival meditation enhance character development and party dynamics
environmental_specialization: Environmental adaptations are specifically designed for hazardous and toxic environments where survival is challenging
Advantages are situational and thematic, maintaining game balance while enhancing immersion
Pressure adaptation and toxic mastery provide unique utility without overshadowing other species' abilities

record.flavor_text: The Kel Dor are a resilient people, forged in the unforgiving crucible of their native planet's toxic atmosphere. Their history is marked by hardship and adaptation, but also by a deep connection to the land and a profound respect for life. When off-world, they wear their breath masks as a symbol of their identity and a reminder of the sacrifices made by their ancestors.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: As a Kel Dor, you have grown accustomed to the harsh conditions on Dorin. Your darkvision allows you to navigate even the most treacherous terrain with ease. However, your reliance on breath masks can make you feel disconnected from the world around you. You may struggle to form close relationships due to your tendency to prioritize functionality over emotional intimacy.
narrative_hooks: A severe dust storm on a remote planet forces you to rely on your Kel Dor skills to survive.
You are approached by a group of Kel Dor elders who possess ancient knowledge about the planet's toxic atmosphere and its secrets.
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Kel Dor often prioritize efficiency and practicality in their interactions. They can come across as aloof or detached, but this is simply a result of their focus on survival and adaptation.
common_motivations: Protecting the integrity of the planet's ecosystem
Uncovering hidden secrets about Dorin's toxic atmosphere
